gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-bengali: Junegull pinches every curve nearly shut, with a lowercase as stout as cast iron capitals. And Noto Sans Bengali, with distinctly open mouths and capitals barely taller than lowercase, gives that heft somewhere quiet to land.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-bhaiksu: Noto Sans Bhaiksuki coils its lowercase into plump, rope-like shapes. Junegull, drawn as if with a round-tipped pen, pinches its curves shut, while the sans body stays easy through its open apertures.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-brahmi: Noto Sans Brahmi holds its mean line high and leaves every curved letter open-ended, the opposite of Junegull's closed shapes. Closed against open: that opposition is the whole appeal.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-bugines: Noto Sans Buginese sits low, its letter mouths open like unjoined chalk arcs. Junegull's crossbars match its stems in weight, so the heading lands firmly while the body below stays light and low.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-buhid: Noto Sans Buhid leaves generous space between its curve ends and stems. Across pages of text that spacing lets the eye glide, whereas Junegull's wire-bent s curves never thin at the spine.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-carian: Stiff wire up top, open scissor blades below. Junegull's unmodulated line meets Noto Sans Carian, whose terminals stay apart, and that clash of closed against open is the pair's best trait.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-chakma: Noto Sans Chakma packs its lowercase up toward the capitals, with uncrowded mouths on the s and c. But Junegull's strength is its constant stroke width, while the sans body is built for running text.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-cham: Tall and rounded, Noto Sans Cham gives its c generous entry space, where Junegull draws curves that match its stems exactly. Closed heading, open body, each making the other louder.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-cheroke: A tall band of letters under short stalks, with a wide gap in each e. Noto Sans Cherokee carries that ease down a whole page, while Junegull keeps zero stroke contrast throughout.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-chorasm: Curves stop short rather than closing, and the big x-height wears short ascenders. Noto Sans Chorasmian stays comfortable paragraph after paragraph, a steady counterweight to Junegull's bent-paperclip, never-swelling heading.
